family.description: Exploratory family comparing the lane route with AFF3CT's [Cassagne2019] fastest-compatible modes at the pin of c077a88b. It is exploratory and has no confirmation: the c077a88b survey's per-frame quality accounting admits neither layered INTER mode as quality-compatible on the recorded corpus (findings.md, criterion REQ-03), and the sum-product INTRA arm has no quality admission either, so a confirmation could select nothing; every cell is a labelled pilot cell. srsRAN [Srsran2026] and OpenAirInterface [OpenAirInterface2026] do not build on the host and xdsopl [Xdsopl2026] exposes no normalized min-sum rule, as that survey records, so AFF3CT is the only measured comparator. The baseline arm of every cell is the gf2-coding LDPC batch decoder on the lane route with the AVX2 lane backend, under selectors that open the lane route to every wave size and edge count, decoding f32 flooding normalized min-sum at factor 0.75 with iteration cap 50 and syndrome stopping, a native build of the story's arms workspace; the candidate is one AFF3CT mode, one clone per pinned worker. Both are launched by the executable digests of build-identity.json. The decoder block of a cell labels its AFF3CT mode: precision, schedule, update rule (decoder.normalization.kind) and native wave size (decoder.batching.batch_size, the wave the arm's prepared quality record states). Per code the cells are: *-layered-f32-inter, layered f32 normalized min-sum INTER with a native wave of eight frames; *-layered-i16-inter, layered i16 normalized min-sum INTER with a native wave of sixteen frames; *-spa-intra, flooding f32 sum-product INTRA with a native wave of one frame, whose runner case keeps the gf2 arm's normalization factor, which the INTRA arm does not read. Quality admission is unestablished in every cell: the cell declares the fastest-quality-compatible tolerance fer_ratio_max, against which P-19 evaluates the paired FER bound of the cell's receipt. Every arm stops on the syndrome at iteration cap 50, but AFF3CT's INTER modes stop a native wave on a packed syndrome decision where the gf2 lane route terminates each frame, so the receipt reports each arm's iterations and no cell compares iteration counts. The measured operation is the steady-state decode of 3be770d5 on one worker: the worker thread pinned to the resolved CPU owns one decoder built before timing, and a timed call decodes the cell's per-worker batch, workload.size.timed_batch, a whole number of the candidate's native waves, including LLR conversion, the gf2 arm's lane transposition in and out, dispatch and extraction of the information-window decisions. Every timed execution checks each frame's bit errors against the arm's prepared quality record. No nested pool is declared. The family declares no more cells than its first ledger attempt admits, as confirmatory-bound.json derives.

effect.rationale: An exploratory family declares no worthwhile speedup.
effect.equivalence_rationale: An exploratory family decides nothing, so it declares no equivalence margin.
effect.material_gap_rationale: An exploratory family declares no material-gap threshold.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: The family selects nothing; the before-after families carry the lane route's budget.
